About the retreat

Above the clouds, life quietly slows down

Ella Dream Mount is a peaceful hillside retreat surrounded by the natural beauty of Rathnagiri Estate — comfortable rooms, panoramic mountain views, authentic local cuisine and warm hospitality.

Just minutes from Ella town and its most iconic attractions, every one of our ten rooms opens to a private balcony, and breakfast is included with every stay.

Ella Railway Station is a scenic 10-minute journey away — we are happy to arrange a tuk-tuk pickup whenever your train arrives.

Explore Ella

Destinations & nearby attractions

The hill country’s most loved sights are minutes away — our team can arrange a private tuk-tuk for each.

5 km · 15 min

Nine Arches Bridge

A colonial-era viaduct set inside a tea forest — arrive close to train time and the valley echoes.

5 km · 20 min

Little Adam's Peak

An easy sunrise walk through tea rows to a 360° view of the Ella valley.

7 km · half day

Ella Rock

The harder climb, and the better view — our trail concierge can time it to miss the crowd and the heat.

8 km · 25 min

Ravana Falls

A wide roadside waterfall named for the Ramayana's Ravana — quietest at dusk.

5 km · 15 min

Demodara Loop

A railway line that loops fully under itself through a tunnel — one of the island’s strangest tracks.
